name: Entity Repeat
description: Repeats entities based on time/recurrence criteria (recurring events/content).
project_description:
Inspired by the Entity Recur project, this module allows for the repeating of entities based on a date field. An optional sub-module "Entity Repeat Group" is included that will associate the repeated entities with the original entity's group .

 Dependencies 
 
 Replicate 
 Recurring Dates Field 
 Recurring Date Field Modular Widgets 
 Group (if using the optional sub-module) 
 
 Installation and setup 
 
 Install the module as you would any other 
 Optionally, install the "Entity Repeat Group" sub-module 
 Add a Recurring Dates field to an entity bundle and set the field widget to

Entity Repeat widget 
 Toggle permissions under Entity Repeat to your liking 
 A checkbox allowing for entity generation will now display along with the

Recurring Dates field if the user has permission 
 Back to top
